articles.headline: Ravens' Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) unsure if he'll play
articles.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson said he's dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unsure if he'll play this week against the Bengals, but is "heading in the right direction" after missing the past two games.
articles.headlineJa: レイブンズのラマー・ジャクソン（足首の高位捻挫）、出場は不透明
articles.descriptionJa: レイブンズのクォーターバック、ラマー・ジャクソンは足首の高位捻挫を抱えており、今週のベンガルズ戦に出場できるか分からないと語った。過去2試合を欠場しているが、「回復に向かっている」としている。
articles.body:
OWINGS MILLS, Md. -- After walking with a limp to the podium after Friday's practice, Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson expressed uncertainty whether he will play Sunday against the Cincinnati Bengals, saying his decision will come down to pain tolerance.

"Right now, I'm heading in the right direction," said Jackson, who is officially listed as questionable. "I can't call it right now."

Jackson said that he is dealing with a high ankle sprain, which he suffered in a win over the Tennessee Titans 19 days ago. He indicated the swelling has gone down significantly, but he is still experiencing pain in his injured left ankle and foot.

The two-time NFL Most Valuable Player doesn't believe he needs to be at 100% to suit up for Sunday's important AFC North game between the Ravens (4-2) and Bengals (3-2).

"If I can just go out there and feel the pain a little bit, I can play," Jackson said. "But if I'm restricted and I can't do what I do, I'm not helping nobody. If I can just go out there and just be a statue and get hit, that's not helping my team at all."

If Jackson can't play, the Ravens will start Tyler Huntley for a third straight week.

There has been increased hope surrounding Jackson after he returned to practice with limited participation all week. He was not seen walking off the field with the rest of the team at the end of Friday's practice, but Ravens coach Jesse Minter mentioned that Jackson "was able to get a pretty good amount of work in."

It's looking like a game-time decision with Jackson.

"I think it's in that phase where we'll certainly go as long as it needs to take," Minter said on when the team will make a decision at starting quarterback.

On Oct. 4, Jackson was injured on the last offensive snap before halftime, when he was sacked from behind. It looked like Titans defensive end Jermaine Johnson II's shoulder landed on the outside of Jackson's left ankle, which caused it to bend awkwardly.

"It was very, very, very, very, very painful," Jackson said.

After getting treatment every day and repeatedly icing the ankle, Jackson felt he turned the corner Sunday, when Baltimore was playing at Cleveland. He ran "a little bit" Sunday and Monday before resuming practice Wednesday.

Jackson doesn't feel pain when he walks, but he does at practice when he tries to plant his foot.

"It's just like trying to run ... can't put too much pressure [on the left foot]," Jackson said.

It was around this time last season, when Jackson missed three games with a hamstring injury. On Friday, he expressed regret rushing back from it because he was never truly healthy the rest of the season.

"I feel like that was dumb a little bit because I was still hurting," Jackson said. "I'm trying to help my team win, but I'm not to my full capability or not even close to it."

The Ravens offense has struggled with its consistency without Jackson. In 14 quarters with Jackson this season, the Ravens have scored 116 points and 14 offensive touchdowns.

articles.headline: Falcons' viral stripes will appear down center of helmets
articles.description: A vertical stripe pattern that the Falcons used in a social media post will appear down the middle of the team's throwback helmets. The stripes drew significant online backlash as some saw similarity to Nazi Germany imagery.
articles.headlineJa: ファルコンズ、SNSで話題のストライプ模様をヘルメット中央に採用
articles.descriptionJa: ファルコンズがSNSの投稿で使用した垂直のストライプ模様が、チームのレトロなヘルメットの中央に採用される。このストライプ模様は、ナチス・ドイツのイメージに似ているとの指摘があり、オンライン上で大きな反発を招いている。
articles.body:
FLOWERY BRANCH, Ga. -- The Atlanta Falcons posted a rendering of their throwback logo Wednesday on social media that created an online backlash, with some posters comparing it to imagery found in Nazi Germany. 

The post featured the franchise's throwback black-and-white bird logo, which it used from the 1960s all the way up to the early 2000s. Behind the logo were vertical stripes in red, black and gold. The colors are a reference to the team's 1966 uniform, which consisted of a red helmet, the black Falcons logo, and black, white and gold striping on the pants.

The Falcons' post remains up, but the team changed its X and Instagram profile photos to one with just the red retro helmet with the black throwback logo on it and no vertical stripes.

The Falcons have worn the retro logo for games every year since 2009 with the exception of several years when the NFL prevented teams from using an alternative helmet color. Atlanta will wear the logo Sunday when it hosts the San Francisco 49ers at Mercedes-Benz Stadium.

The presentation of the retro logo on top of the vertical striping in those colors on that specific social media post seems to be the object of controversy. The stripes will appear down the middle of the team's red helmet and not behind the logo like the graphic showed.

The Falcons declined to comment on the situation. An NFL spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment from The Associated Press.

Falcons owner Arthur Blank is Jewish and has donated millions to Holocaust remembrance organizations through the Molly Blank Fund, which is named after his mother. In 2023, Blank donated $1.5 million to the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum.

articles.headline: Bets for National Tight Ends Day: Props and picks for Sunday's games
articles.description: In recognition of National Tight Ends Day, we thought we'd share our favorite bets for the versatile playmakers.
articles.headlineJa: 「全米タイトエンドの日」の賭け：日曜日の試合に向けたプロップベットと予想
articles.descriptionJa: 「全米タイトエンドの日」にちなんで、多才なプレーメーカーたちに関するおすすめの賭けを紹介する。
articles.body:
For NFL fans, the fourth Sunday in October isn't just another weekend of the season. Since its accidental inception in 2018, National Tight Ends Day has become a day of celebration for the position.

Last year, tight ends represented their position on the holiday by scoring 12 touchdowns. The record for any week since 2000 is 22 touchdowns, set in Week 1 of 2015. Tight ends across the league recorded a total of 108 receptions on the holiday in 2025. They caught 178 passes the previous season, which is the most on a single day in the Super Bowl era, according to ESPN Research.

We asked our analysts to give their favorite tight end plays for Sunday. Here's what they found.

Jump to:

Best bets | TE odds

Best bets

George Kittle receiving yards OVER 69.5 (-110)

Matt Bowen: With Mike Evans expected to miss Sunday's game versus the Falcons, Kittle should play a key role in Kyle Shanahan's passing script. Kittle had 69 yards receiving in the 49ers' Monday night win over the Commanders, and he has topped the 70-yard mark in three of six games played. Let's take the former Hawkeye to hit the over in Atlanta.

Dallas Goedert receiving yards OVER 39.5 (-112)

Bowen: Quarterback Tanner McKee looked Goedert's way eight times in his first start, and the tight end caught six for 61 yards. That gives us something concrete with the quarterback change. Dallas allows tight ends to catch nearly 84% of their targets, so this is a good matchup for McKee to keep using Goedert.

AJ Barner anytime TD (+260)

Liz Loza: Barner is second on the Seahawks in routes run behind only Jaxon Smith-Njigba. He ranks eighth at the position in route participation (76.5%). An obvious contributor in the red area of the field, Barner has drawn six high-value targets over his last four games. With fellow tight end Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) sidelined, Barner's volume figures to hold. The 24-year-old draws a plus matchup against a Chiefs defense that has invited the second-most looks to opposing ends while allowing four scores to the position in five outings.

Tyler Higbee receiving yards OVER 38.5 (-114)

Eric Moody: Higbee should see more targets with Davante Adams sidelined by a hamstring injury. Before being held to 22 receiving yards against the Cardinals in Week 6, Higbee had three straight games with at least six targets and 62 receiving yards. Now he faces a Raiders defense that has allowed 53.8 receiving yards per game to tight ends.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany hospitalized after collapsing at training
articles.description: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany is undergoing tests in hospital after collapsing during a training session Friday, the German club confirmed.
articles.headlineJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンのコンパニー監督、練習中に倒れ入院
articles.descriptionJa: ドイツのバイエルン・ミュンヘンは、ヴィンセント・コンパニー監督が金曜日の練習中に倒れ、現在病院で検査を受けていることを認めた。
articles.body:
Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany is undergoing tests in hospital after collapsing during a training session on Friday, the German club confirmed.

Kompany had been suffering with a viral infection that was affecting his legs over the past week, though he was on the sideline for Bayern's Champions League match with Arsenal on Wednesday.

Bayern said that Kompany, 40, collapsed while watching a training session for the club's reserve team on Friday and required medical care.

"Kompany is undergoing thorough examinations in hospital and will remain under medical care," the club said. "His coaching staff will oversee training and match activities until further notice."

The club's director of sport, Max Eberl, said Kompany would be given "all the time he needs."

"Vincent Kompany's health is our top priority," Eberl said in a statement. "We at FC Bayern will do everything we can to ensure he makes a speedy recovery.

"Vinnie is receiving all the necessary medical care and support, and all the time he needs. His coaching team, in whom we have complete confidence, will take over his duties. All of us at FC Bayern wish Vinnie a speedy recovery."

Kompany was subdued and remained seated in Bayern's 6-1 win over Leipzig in the Bundesliga on Saturday.

Eberl said at the time that Kompany, who reportedly needed help to climb stairs, had been struggling with both the virus and a hip injury.

Ahead of the Arsenal game, assistant Aaron Danks assumed Kompany's training and media duties Tuesday.

"It has affected his legs at times and he's felt some pain," Danks said of Kompany on Tuesday.

"It's just a virus. The doctors, the experts, know way more than I do. The most important thing we've just encouraged is that he rests, he takes the time he needs, whatever that may be, however long that may be."

Following Wednesday's match, Kompany acknowledged he tried to push through the illness and failed to heed the signals from his body.

Bayern Munich, who are top of the German Bundesliga and level on points with Borussia Dortmund, next visit Freiburg on Sunday.

Kompany joined Bayern in 2024 from Burnley and has won the German league twice since then. Kompany's team also reached the Champions League semifinals and won the German Cup last season.

Among a raft of teams wishing Kompany well was Manchester City, where he was the long-time captain and won the Premier League four times.

"Everyone at Manchester City is wishing a speedy recovery to our former captain and Club legend, Vincent Kompany," City posted on X. "Get well soon, Vinny."

Information from The Associated Press contributed to this report

articles.headline: Bears TE Cole Kmet out for season after knee injury vs. Patriots
articles.description: Bears tight end Cole Kmet will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after he suffered a serious right knee injury during Chicago's 30-24 win over New England.
articles.headlineJa: BearsのTEコール・クメット、パトリオッツ戦での膝の負傷により今季絶望
articles.descriptionJa: Bearsのタイトエンド、コール・クメットは、ニューイングランドに30-24で勝利した試合中に右膝を深刻に負傷し、2026年シーズンの残り全試合を欠場することになった。
articles.body:
CHICAGO -- Bears tight end Cole Kmet will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after he suffered a serious right knee injury during Chicago's 30-24 win over New England, coach Ben Johnson announced Friday.

The Bears will place Kmet on season-ending injured reserve following testing Friday morning after he was unable to bear weight on his leg. In seven games, Kmet had 10 catches for 87 yards and a touchdown.

"He's everything we want to be about here," Johnson said. "He's one of the glue guys. He's one of the guys that I can count on, whether it's a messaging standpoint or getting the pulse of the team. He's going to be sorely missed."

With 5:46 to play in the fourth quarter, Kmet caught an 8-yard pass from Caleb Williams before colliding with Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez and linebacker Robert Spillane as he ran up the Bears' sideline. The tight end immediately grabbed for his knee and had to be carted to the locker room.

Current and former teammates, including Patriots safety Kevin Byard III, gathered around Kmet as he was loaded onto a cart. He gave the crowd a thumbs-up as he was transported through the northwest tunnel inside Soldier Field.

"It stinks, it does. I hate it for him. I hate it for his teammates as well," Johnson said. "And yet the train keeps rolling along. Someone else has to step up."

Kmet, 27, was drafted by the Bears in 2020 and has missed only one game over his seven NFL seasons. He has logged the eighth-highest snap count on offense (62.19%) this season and joined Hall of Famer Mike Ditka on Thursday as just the second tight end in franchise history to top 3,000 career receiving yards after he caught three passes for 28 yards.

He saw a role shift since Johnson took over in 2025 but remained a vital piece of the Bears' operation despite his production as a pass catcher dipping.

Without Kmet, Chicago will lean into Colston Loveland and rookie Sam Roush. Other options further down the Bears' depth chart are Stephen Carlson and Qadir Ismail on the practice squad and undrafted free agent Hayden Large, who is eligible to come off injured reserve.

The Bears play some of the highest rates of 12 and 13 personnel (multiple-TE sets) in the NFL. While Kmet's absence will undoubtedly be felt in a multitude of ways, Johnson said the offense won't change, particularly what it asks of its tight ends.

"We trained all our tight ends to be able to do all the jobs," Johnson said. "I don't see us really changing who we are or what we do as a result of that. ... There's a lot of solutions out there to make sure that we can still run the ball, pass protect and our route running, I think we're gonna be OK."

articles.headline: Cam Skattebo set to return to Giants RB mix after being 'taught a lesson'
articles.description: After zero carries in Week 6, Cam Skattebo says he took a step back to evaluate and correct, and Giants' coach says he should return to the running back mix vs. the Texans.
articles.headlineJa: 「教訓を得た」カム・スカッテボ、ジャイアンツのRB陣に復帰へ
articles.descriptionJa: 第6週でキャリー回数がゼロだったカム・スカッテボは、一度立ち止まって評価と修正を行ったと語っており、ジャイアンツのコーチは、テキサンズ戦でランニングバック陣に復帰する見込みだとしている。
articles.body:
EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. -- Cam Skattebo had a "good week" of practice and should return to the running back mix for the New York Giants against the Houston Texans, coach John Harbaugh said Friday.

Skattebo didn't have a single carry in Sunday's 34-27 loss to the New Orleans Saints. He landed on the bench for most of last week's game after a crucial overtime fumble in a tie with the Washington Commanders. It was his fifth fumble in 13 career games.

"It's been good, you know. I think I got taught a lesson," Skattebo said. "I don't know if that's from them or from myself, but I kind of had to step back and look at it and figure out why I was doing the things I was doing, what was happening. Came to practice, corrected those things, worked on them. Ready to go back out there and play ball."

The Giants had Najee Harris, who was released Tuesday, Tyrone Tracy Jr. and Devin Singletary ahead of Skattebo in the rotation against the Saints. Skattebo played six snaps after averaging 42 over the first five games.

The Giants praised Skattebo this week for handling it like a "pro" and trying to correct the mistakes.

"He was always going to be a big part of our season," Harbaugh said. "And he had a heck of a week of practice; all the backs did."

The second-year running back knows he still has to prove it on the field.

"I didn't do anything yet," Skattebo said. "I took care of the ball during practice, and whatever my role is on Sunday is going to be my role and I'm going to give it everything I've got."

Harbaugh said Harris' release was about setting a clearer course at running back and seemed to indicate that a four-man rotation was too much. Skattebo and Tracy are expected to split the primary role this week against a Texans defense that ranks third in the NFL against the run.

Tracy worked his way back into the mix after being buried on the depth chart early this season. He had a missed block in the preseason that led to quarterback Jaxson Dart getting sent to the medical tent and fumbled in the opener. But Tracy had a receiving and a rushing touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Saints to help him earn more reps.

Harbaugh talked earlier in the week about how none of the running backs have taken the reins and run with them this season. He is waiting for someone to step up.

Skattebo is the team's leading rusher with 81 carries for 294 yards (3.6 YPC) with one touchdown. Giants running backs collectively have averaged 2.4 yards per carry this season.

They know the pressure is on. They took notice with Harris being released.

"Nobody's safe. It's as simple as that," Skattebo said. "I think when we go on the field and we perform, if we're not performing, we understand there's a possibility of not being here. If I don't perform, I know there's a possibility of me not being here. We came in this week. We continue to work. We know where we're at. We know what we have. If we put that to display, we're going to be just fine."

articles.headline: Browns RBs Quinshon Judkins, Dylan Sampson expected to play
articles.description: The Browns' top two running backs, Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson, are expected to play against the Titans after being sidelined with injuries.
articles.headlineJa: BrownsのRBクインション・ジャドキンスとディラン・サンプソン、出場見込み
articles.descriptionJa: 怪我で戦列を離れていたBrownsの主力ランニングバック、クインション・ジャドキンスとディラン・サンプソンは、タイタンズ戦に出場する見込みだ。
articles.body:
BEREA, Ohio -- The Cleveland Browns' top two running backs, Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson, are expected to play against the Tennessee Titans after being sidelined with injuries.

Judkins, who leads the team with 230 rushing yards, was not listed on the injury report Friday after sitting out last week's game due to an ankle injury.

Browns coach Todd Monken also said he anticipates Sampson, who opened the season as the backup to Judkins, will be activated off injured reserve after missing the last five games because of a knee injury.

Sampson sustained the injury while returning a kickoff in Cleveland's season-opening loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.

articles.headline: AC Milan condemn racist abuse of Mike Maignan after red card vs. Bournemouth
articles.description: AC Milan have condemned what they called "serious and unacceptable racist abuse" directed at goalkeeper Mike Maignan on social media following his red card in Thursday's Europa League loss to Bournemouth.
articles.headlineJa: ACミラン、ボーンマス戦でのレッドカードを受けたマイク・メニャンへの人種差別的暴言を非難
articles.descriptionJa: ACミランは、木曜日のヨーロッパリーグにおけるボーンマス戦でのレッドカードを受けた後、ゴールキーパーのマイク・メニャンに対してSNS上で行われた「深刻かつ受け入れがたい人種差別的な暴言」を非難した。
articles.body:
AC Milan have condemned what they called "serious and unacceptable racist abuse" directed at goalkeeper Mike Maignan on social media, following his red card in Thursday's Europa League loss at Bournemouth.

The France international was shown a straight red card and conceded a penalty in the 27th minute after putting his gloves in the face of United States midfielder Tyler Adams and pushing him to the ground.

"AC Milan strongly condemns all forms of racism and discrimination, which are unacceptable and have no place either on or off the pitch," the club said in a statement on Friday.

"The Club expresses its full solidarity and support for Mike and reaffirms its ongoing commitment to promoting the values of respect, inclusion and equality. These are the values of AC Milan."

Bournemouth converted the resulting penalty following the sending off to make the score 2-0 and went on to add another goal in the second half to record a dominant 3-0 win. It was Milan's first defeat this season in all competitions.

In their statement, Milan called for unity from supporters and the Italian league to combat racism.

"Finally, we need to stand together as Milanisti and as a league," the club said. "The only way we can restore Italian football to where it belongs is by coming together and embracing the best of what we can be, both individually and collectively.

"We all want to win, but we need to win the right way with dignity, mutual respect and class."

Maignan, who is Black, has previously spoken out about being the subject of racist abuse.

During an Italian Serie A game at Udinese in January 2024, Maignan walked off the field after being subjected to racist chants by opposition fans -- prompting the match to be suspended briefly during the first half.

"They made monkey noises and it's not the first time it's happened to me," Maignan told DAZN at the time.

"They must hand out very strong sanctions, because talking no longer does anything.

"We have to say that what they are doing is wrong. It is not the whole crowd, most fans want to cheer on their team and jeer you, that's normal, but not this."

Milan's next game sees them visit Udinese on Sunday.

Information from The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Phishing email to Knicks employees an 'unfortunate mistake,' MSG spokesman says
articles.description: A Madison Square Garden spokesman admitted fault that employees in Knicks business operations and at the arena received a phishing email posing as an opportunity to claim an NBA championship ring, calling the incident "an unfortunate mistake."
articles.body:
A Madison Square Garden spokesperson admitted fault that employees in Knicks business operations and at the arena received a phishing email posing as an opportunity to claim an NBA championship ring, calling the incident "an unfortunate mistake."

The Athletic reported Thursday that some employees received an email last month saying "your Employee Championship Ring is here" that said they could choose from a pair of options at "no cost to you."

When the employees clicked on a link in the email, The Athletic reported, they were informed that they had failed a phishing test and would have to attend a mandatory cybersecurity class.

"The company had previously sent out an email to its corporate team as a simulation of a phishing attack designed to strengthen our security against hackers," the MSG spokesman said in a statement Friday. "MSG was recently hacked and extorted using an employee login and password obtained through a similar phishing attack. Using the rings as a lure to gain employees attention was an unfortunate mistake."

The spokesman noted that the company is giving more than 275 championship rings and jewelry to players, coaches and employees, among others, valuing the total at more than $3.7 million.

Along with the phishing email, The Athletic reported that Knicks assistant coaches did not receive their championship rings during Tuesday's title ceremony ahead of the season opener and were instead handed empty boxes, in part because they had not yet been fitted for the rings. A source confirmed to ESPN that several Knicks coaches did not receive rings.

The coaches' reaction to the delayed rings ranged from annoyance to anger, according to The Athletic. A delay in some rings being handed out also occurred for the Oklahoma City Thunder after their 2025 title, The Athletic noted.

The Knicks ended a 53-year championship drought when they defeated the San Antonio Spurs in last season's NBA Finals. On Tuesday, the team had not one but two new banners in the rafters, as one was also added to honor the Knicks' win in the NBA Cup during the 2025-26 season.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona to end up signing Sullivan?
articles.description: Cavan Sullivan has a pre-contract agreement with Manchester City, but could Barcelona swoop up and sign the young American prospect? Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.body:
Barcelona are among several major European clubs tracking Philadelphia Union midfielder Cavan Sullivan, while Como attacking midfielder Nico Paz is being watched by Chelsea and Manchester United. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Barcelona are among several major European clubs tracking Philadelphia Union midfielder Cavan Sullivan, according to Sport. Although the United States international previously signed a pre-contract agreement to join Manchester City when he turns 18, uncertainty around City's financial sanctions has alerted Barcelona, Real Madrid, Chelsea, Liverpool and Paris Saint-Germain.

- Manchester United are monitoring Como attacking midfielder Nico Paz ahead of next season, while Chelsea are also keen, Nicolò Schira reports. Real Madrid hold an €80 million clause to re-sign him, which becomes valid in early July, but Como are eager to keep the 22-year-old Argentina international after his two goals and an assist in their 4-1 Champions League victory over Manchester United.

- Chelsea are keeping tabs on Liverpool midfielder Florian Wirtz following advice from Xabi Alonso to stay attentive if his Anfield exit becomes possible, according to TEAMtalk. The Blues are currently maintaining a watching brief on the 23-year-old Germany international, while Liverpool remain determined to see his move succeed.

- Galatasaray are pulling out of a potential move for Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes, leaving Saudi Arabia as his most likely destination if he departs Old Trafford, per TEAMtalk. With less than a year on his contract and talks over a new deal not progressing, the 32-year-old's high wage demands restrict his options in Europe, whereas Al Hilal remain attentive.

- Liverpool have held contact with representatives of Borussia Dortmund midfielder Felix Nmecha, reports Sky Germany. However, no formal offer is being prepared for the 26-year-old, with the Reds placing AS Monaco's Lamine Camara and Bournemouth's Alex Scott higher on their priority list.

Other rumors

- Aston Villa's Unai Emery and former Germany boss Julian Nagelsmann are considered top candidates for Manchester United if the club decide to replace head coach Michael Carrick. (Guardian)

- Arsenal have revived their interest in Atlético Madrid winger Álex Baena ahead of a potential January move. (Football Transfers)

- Liverpool are prepared to trigger their €55 million permanent transfer option for on-loan defender Ronald Araújo if his strong performances continue. (Marca)

- Manchester United, Manchester City, Brentford, Aston Villa, Newcastle United, Everton and Sunderland have all scouted 18-year-old Twente defender Ruud Nijstad. (TEAMtalk)

- Chelsea youngster Kendry Páez is ready to seek a departure during the January transfer window. (Nicolò Schira)

- Arda Güler has officially signed a new contract extension committing his future to Real

articles.headline: Ex-Laker Dalton Knecht joins Knicks on two-way contract
articles.description: Former Lakers first-round pick Dalton Knecht has agreed to a two-way deal with the Knicks, his agents told ESPN's Shams Charania.
articles.body:
It didn't take long for Dalton Knecht to find a new NBA team. Just days after the Los Angeles Lakers waived their 2024 first-round pick, the New York Knicks agreed to sign the 6-foot-6 forward to a two-way deal, his agents at Excel Sports Management told ESPN's Shams Charania on Friday.

Knecht, selected with the No. 17 pick in 2024 after a standout junior season at the University of Tennessee, will look for a fresh start with the defending champs and try to tap into the promise he showed as a rookie in L.A.

During a nine-game stretch in November during the 2024-25 season, Knecht averaged 18.9 points on 55.4% shooting (52.2% from 3), 4.9 rebounds and 1.3 assists.

Knecht finished his rookie season averaging 9.1 points on 46.1% shooting (37.6% from 3) and 2.8 rebounds in 19.2 minutes across 78 games. In his second year, his playing time was cut to 10.2 minutes in 54 games, and he averaged 4.2 points on 45.5% shooting (34.2% from 3) and 1.4 rebounds.

The 25-year-old Knecht also received interest from the Cleveland Cavaliers, Sacramento Kings and Minnesota Timberwolves, sources told Charania.

New York will have to waive a two-way player to make room for Knecht. The Knicks currently have guard Jaden Akins and forwards Kevin McCullar Jr. and Tyler Nickel occupying their three allotted two-way roster spots.
